name: palladium
title: Palladium fiscal invoice / credit note
description: Drafted from Eximium Premium Brands PDFs generated by Palladium Software. The number and date use 'Number:' and MM/dd/yyyy; the buyer fields are Customer Name / Address / TIN / VAT. The A4 item header collapses to LINEHSCODEITEMDESCRIPTIONQUANTITYUNITVATTOTALINC, and the columns are printed as one concatenated run, e.g. '185434000VOL018BLUV18X-BLUEBERRY 1EA 1.00 0.16 1.00'. The VAT column is a money amount: the row pattern exposes it as vatAmount and leaves the VAT percentage to vatRate, so 1.00 + 0.16 reproduces the printed invoice total of 1.16 without treating 0.16 as a rate. Prices are VAT-inclusive (vatInclusive=true): the fiscal request sends the 1.16 unit price with taxInclusive=true, and the gateway backs the VAT out at the company rate. Set defaultTaxType to STANDARD, ZERO_RATED or EXEMPT; vatRate is the STANDARD percentage (0.155 = 15.5%) and is ignored for the other two — keep it above 0 for STANDARD, since the parser reads 0 as a zero-rated business. Credit notes announce 'Fiscal Credit Note', use a CN number, and carry the reversed invoice under 'Reference:'. Confirm against a real captured job before rolling out; a VAT amount of 1.00 or more needs a wider row rule.
